Water consumption was lowered in all dosed rat groups and in male mice that received 1600 ppm or more and in female mice at 800 ppm or higher. Mean body weight gain was depressed dose-related in all rat groups and in mice that received 800 ppm or more. In some rats receiving 1600 or 3200 ppm, crater-like foci with black content in the cardiac part of the stomach were noted. No premature deaths occurred in rats. Survival was reduced in some mice at 800 ppm or higher, all mice died at 3200 ppm. No compound-related lesions were identified in mice at necropsy. Hematology, clinical biochemistry and histopathological examinations were not performed in any species.
